parts.part: The Atlas archaeon harvester does not index archaeon/envgate or archaeon/envgate2
evidence: atlas/harvest/archaeon_campaigns.py:59 (only paths matching archaeon/(campaign\d+)/ are grouped; others are dropped)
archaeon/envgate/PREREG.json and archaeon/envgate2/PREREG.json exist but match neither prefix
atlas/registry.json:319-324 (only local run_logs root is the cw01 experiments dir)
roles/Nestor/campaigns/z80atlas-2026-09-19/PREREGISTRATION.md exists but is outside every harvester path
Grep 'envgate|z80atlas' (case-insensitive) over atlas/ returns no matches

parts.part: No lens field exists in atlas/
evidence: Grep 'lens' (case-insensitive) over atlas/ (all .py, .sql, registry.json, README.md) returns no matches

Grep 'varied|held' over atlas/ finds only atlas/sql/010_m1-1c645957_research_policy.sql:71 (primitive_use.state value VARIED, a primitive-presence state, not a varied/held/observed lens field) and two unrelated comments

notes: Checked at HEAD 59b94b4e. The claim restates roles/Artemis/selftest/runs/R-34/REPORT.md:36-38 and :114-115. One caveat: atlas/harvest/commits.py:28-43 records every commit on every ref (subject, classes, n_paths), so commits that touch envgate/z80atlas paths do end up in atlas.git_commit as commit metadata. It stores no per-path campaign, experiment or file rows, so these campaigns are still not indexed as campaigns or experiments. That caveat does not break the claim.
